rows.feature: Approve or update many items at once
rows.desc: Staff can tick several items and handle them all in one click, instead of one at a time. For example, approving a batch of attendance excuses, or placing new students into their classes.

rows.feature: Look back at past school years
rows.desc: Every part of the system now has a school-year selector at the top of the page. Staff can view last year's records without leaving the page they are on.
One page shows every student's attendance for the term. Staff can filter it and download it to Excel.
A holiday or no-class day can now be set for just one level, such as Primary 1, instead of the whole school. Attendance is closed for that level only.
The finance team will see each student's invoices and payments in the SIS, on pages that look like the QuickBooks pages they already use. Every change is recorded.

rows.feature: Correct, cancel or refund an invoice
rows.desc: Staff can correct an invoice, cancel an unpaid one, add a discount or give a refund, all from the SIS. QuickBooks updates by itself.
Each applicant's registration and enrolment fees now show whether the invoice was sent or paid. A list shows which applicants still need an invoice.
Billing is being tested on a practice copy of the school's QuickBooks. Going live needs approval from the person who manages the school's QuickBooks account.
